diagnostic_follow_up.reason: Throttle counters increased during the approximately two-second stage, while the five-second telemetry interval produced only one pre-completion sample. This is not a correctness failure and is not proof of overheating, but short-run telemetry must be dense enough to characterize runtime thermal and frequency behavior.

limits: This result admits only the frozen-input correctness stage on the recorded DK-2500 CPU FP32 software and artifact identity.
It does not establish short-run performance, 30-minute stability, real-time behavior, robot task success, collision safety, E-stop effectiveness or accelerator compatibility.
The observed throttle-counter increments do not identify their cause and cannot be interpreted as a thermal failure from this run alone.
